# TopologicalFlowSwitching

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The phenomenon where the global connectivity and topology of a flow network determine the switching pathways and interactions between hysteretic elements. Highlights how network topology can be engineered to control memory dynamics, enabling scalable and reconfigurable computing fabrics in TCC.
